USB 3.2 Gen 1 (SuperSpeed USB 5Gbps, formerly USB 3.0 / USB 3.1 Gen 1): 5 Gbit/s;

Thunderbolt™ 5: 80 Gbit/s (bidirectional), up to 120 Gbit/s in bandwidth boost mode for video-intensive applications.
